Prove the public managed-job lifecycle and bounded audit retention: session ownership, exact spawn replay, privacy-safe list/status, identity-bracketed native containment-group resource point/watch views with stable membership and truthful breakaway coverage, stdin write/close, dual-stream cursors, full-budget single-stream output, exit wait, renewal, exact stop, session-end cleanup and retry, then retention plan/apply/readback with malformed and expired drops.
Prove plan-only default, exact apply/readback, durable status, rollback, retained-backup finalize, and changed-destination refusal through the public agenterm-cu CLI.

Prove plan-only default, exact move apply (source absent, destination digest preserved), durable status, exact rollback, replace-backup finalize, installed-before-retire crash recovery, and changed-destination refusal through the public agenterm-cu CLI.

Prove setup check is zero-write, apply atomically installs one exact owned launcher, repeat is idempotent, the launcher executes the packaged binary, and foreign collisions are preserved through the public agenterm-cu CLI.

Prove setup refresh serializes with admission, defers without stopping or replacing one exact resident managed-job owner, and leaves cleanup to the owner's explicit lifecycle through the public agenterm-cu CLI.

Prove capabilities, permissions and doctor share one typed declaration; doctor derives ready/degraded from bounded live probes without setup or consent mutation; and setup --check remains zero-publish.

Prove the fixed browser bridge public CLI has bounded exact-connection inventory, typed missing/malformed identity refusal, an actuation gate, and stdout-clean foreign-origin rejection without installing an extension.

Prove the macOS public CoreSimulator CLI has bounded device and already-booted app inventories, hides app paths, rejects invalid bounds, and refuses mutation without actuate; the court never boots or changes an app.
Prove the public current-host resource snapshot is complete, bounded and read-only; strict free and reclaimable available memory remain distinct, and Windows load unavailability is explicit.

Measure the one fail-closed ACU retirement contract: capability/evidence ledger, three-host task registration, six-cell Candidate wiring, production Bun/MCU dependencies and the temporary adapter report. Remaining blockers are successful audit output, never hidden green retirement.
Prove ACU reports its on-demand coordinator and per-resource owner topology without inventing a global daemon, probing child liveness, creating durable state or writing an effect receipt.
Prove the public current-host block-device inventory is bounded, read-only, capacity-exact and excludes stable hardware identifiers on each native platform.
Prove native peripheral inventory is bounded, read-only, provider-explicit and uses stable installation-scoped opaque identities without disclosing serials, addresses or native paths.
Prove host and boot identities are stable installation-scoped pseudonyms, observation never enrolls state and no hardware or native process identity leaks.
Prove device watch uses bounded complete-snapshot diffs, suppresses unprovable provider transitions and exposes only installation-scoped pseudonymous events.
Prove Unix native device claim, exact replay, lease authority refusal, bounded binary I/O, renewal, explicit release and session-owned cleanup over one owner-bound private PTY fixture.
Prove the public read-only process.set-priority plan is identity-bound, expiring, digest-sealed and mutation-free; Windows must fail with its typed semantic gap.
Prove bounded console-session observation and exact-session mutation-free lock planning on macOS, with truthful no-effect platform refusal elsewhere.

Prove exact default-output observation and mutation-free, approval-bound audio planning on macOS, with truthful no-effect platform refusal on Linux and Windows; audible mutation is outside this court.
Prove bounded native service observation/planning plus request-bound, target-locked one-call no-effect replay on macOS/Linux, with truthful provider refusal on Windows.

Prove exact-object stop/resume with start-identity binding and scheduler read-back on macOS/Linux, typed unsupported refusal on Windows, no-op behavior, and stale-identity refusal through the public CLI.

Prove exact-object signal delivery, stale-identity refusal, Unix delivery-vs-acknowledgement semantics, STOP/CONT read-back, Windows typed POSIX refusal, and explicit SIGKILL exit verification through the public CLI.

Kill the ACU owner during durable pre-stable tree freeze, then prove a fresh ACU owner resumes only exact start identities, reports typed recovery, never redelivers the interrupted signal, and leaves no frozen orphan.
Prove identity-bracketed bounded descriptor, memory-region and native-thread inventories through the public CLI; Windows must refuse unsupported private mechanisms by type.
Prove bounded rich process filters, CPU sampling, plaintext-safe command matching, stable pagination and typed pid tree file/socket detail through the public CLI.
Prove an identity-bracketed bounded native socket inventory against an invocation-owned loopback TCP listener; Windows must refuse unsupported private mechanisms by type.
Prove Linux cgroup v2 observation brackets the exact process identity, membership path and opened cgroup directory while non-Linux hosts return a typed not-applicable result.

Prove macOS host-open rejects option-like targets, dispatches one shell-free argv target to a background fixture, records crash-persistent evidence, and never upgrades dispatcher acceptance into handler verification.
Prove permission status is read-only, macOS already-granted open is a verified no-op, and hosts without a generic pane fail typed without opening UI.
Prove macOS notification dispatch rejects oversized content, passes bounded text as argv rather than code, redacts durable evidence, and distinguishes dispatcher acceptance from user presentation.
Prove bounded DNS plus TCP observation against one invocation-owned loopback listener, exact reachable and unreachable attempt counts, and orphan-free cleanup on every native host.
Prove the native route inventory is shell-free, bounded, identity-bearing, schema-complete and mutation-free on Windows, Linux and macOS.
Prove native interface inventory is bounded, identity-bearing, schema-complete and mutation-free on Windows, Linux and macOS.

Prove qjswasm can orchestrate one durable headless ACU PTY across native hosts: inventory, persisted identity-bound snapshot/diff, exact-grid resize with lease cleanup, event continuation, input/wait/exit, same-name restart refusal and cleanup.
